Summary:
- Cadence is the most popular singer, dancer, and DJ on Club Penguin.
- She made her first in-game appearance in September 2008 and her debut as a named, meetable "mascot" character in January 2009.
- Primarily performs Pop and EDM songs, but enjoys nearly every genre of music.
- Has an appreciation for the arts, even the ones she isn't talented in (painting, video games, etc.)
- Canonically owns the post-Operation: Blackout version of the Dance Club.
- Has several songs that were released to iTunes in real life, one of which (The Party Starts Now) was the #1 Most Downloaded for a day.
- "DJ K-Dance" is a common nickname of her's; she'll both answer to the name and address herself as such in some situations.
- Uses slang terms unique to Club Penguin, including (but not limited to): Ice (cooler than cool), Iggy (shorthand for 'igloo', the players' homes in Club Penguin), and Grub (catch-all negative exclamation).
- Has appeared in French, Spanish, and Brazilian servers speaking a mix of English and the servers' official languages, implying she knows SOME French/Spanish/Portuguese but is not fluent enough for a full, non-English back-and-forth conversation. No existing evidence of knowing any other languages besides what was previously mentioned.
- Has two big fears: bugs, and being alone. Will answer with the first if asked, will only share the second with those she trusts.
- Sees strip poker as little different from any other game. Tries to win accordingly, but will congratulate others for doing well. Especially those who get along with her, but less so characters who actively dislike her and vice versa.
- "Nudity" is commonplace in the clothing-optional, Rated-G world of Club Penguin, so Cadence will fail to recognize the innapropriacy of stripping naked. This isn't her being dumb, it's just culture shock, and she'll catch on if another opponent targets her with an explanation.
- Aged Up: Assumed to have aged up over the course of her source material's lifespan. Recurring parties like the Music Jam and Halloween Party are suffixed by a year (i.e. Music Jam 2009), indicating a realtime passage of time. It's impossible for Cadence to have been a teenager in both 2009 and 2017.

NOTICE: Club Penguin Island was intended to be a reboot of the Club Penguin franchise, confirmed by the game's epilogue where events that already took place on the original Club Penguin (the discovery of Puffles, Sensei opening his dojo, etc.) were covered in a "where are they now" segment. As the original Club Penguin is a much more fleshed-out world, please exclusively draw from that game for ACTUAL lore and leave events exclusive to Club Penguin Island as "dreams" (i.e. Nami's "4Kids dub", Toph's "ATLA movie")

Personality:
- Loves music and anything that has to do with it. There are no "bad" music genres in her mind.
- Extremely excitable and expressive. Whether positive or negative, any reaction out of her will be turned up to 11.
- Confident in herself, can mentally recover from a string of bad luck with just one or two wins.
- Has an easy time making fast friends with others and enjoys doing so. Making new friends is her primary motivation for playing a game like strip poker in a place like the Inventory.
- Will quickly attempt to cheer up gloomy characters and help shy characters overcome their social insecurities. Success requires the other character to WANT to be helped, but Cadence should ALWAYS make the attempt.
- Good sport, will congratulate all players regardless of the outcome of the game.
- Favorite Foods: Pizza, Coffee, Grapefruits, Ice Cream, Chocolate
- Tends to speak at least one work in all-caps (Note: for SPNatI formatting, use italics instead.)
- Social media enthusiast, often speaks in slang/hashtags and unironically says "LOL" out loud. May take a selfie mid-match.
- Impatient. Can handle someone taking off accessories for the first couple of rounds, but gets very bored very quickly if it keeps happening. Starts losing her composure if boredom sets in.
- Does not hold back the waterworks well when she gets sad. Gets frustrated about this.
- Difficult to anger; only gets mildly annoyed from losing three or more hands in a row, losing with 3 of a Kind or better, or being antagonized.
- Never instigates rude/antagonistic behavior, but may retort if deliberately insulted. Will also come to the aid of others being insulted.

Great Topics:
- Other Singers/Musicians: If an opponent is a fellow musical artist like herself, she'd love to inquire more, and potentially even collaborate.
- Her Music Career: Had a meteoric rise to fame in the early 2010s. Ask about it and she'd be happy to tell you.
- How to Get Famous: Has a pretty profound advice on this topic, especially for a kid's MMO, but it boils down to how it's impossible for anyone to "teach" people how to get famous. Great to ask, though!
- Surfing: A second-favorite hobby she aquired in the Summer of 2013.
- Pizza: A favorite food of hers. Preferred toppings are Anchovies, Shrimp, Calamari, and Seaweed, not necessarily all at once. Likes her pizza sauce with a spicy kick. Also a big fan of dessert pizza.
- Pets: Owns a pet puffle (native fauna to Club Penguin) named Lolz.
- The Penguin Band: Her inspiration for becoming an artist herself. Has since eclipsed them in popularity, and is unsure how she feels about this.
- Franky: Lead singer of the Penguin Band and Cadence's closest friend/roommate. The Club Penguin mascot actors for Cadence and Franky used to heavily tease a relationship between the two yet Disney never officially confirmed it. (Note: Try to avoid directly confirming or deconfirming a relationship; the less fanon, the better)

Okay Topics:
- Acting: Loves movies/theatre, but discovered acting wasn't what she wanted to do with her life. Was invited to attend the 2009 and 2010 Penguin Play Awards and hosted the Hollywood Party regardless, and also wrote the soundtrack to "Penguin High 3" in canon.
- Art: She might only have talent in digital music, singing, and dancing, but Cadence has heaps of respect for ALL forms of art.
- Coffee: Her Dance Club is right next door to a coffeehouse, and she occasionally pops in for a cup. Mention drinks and she's likely to bring this up, but it's not a strong enough topic for a full conversation.
- Sugar: Although she's SUPPOSEDLY a bit of a health nut according to her official bio, with favorite foods listed as grapefruit and coconut water, Disney has always portrayed Cadence as having quite the sweet tooth and tendency to indulge. As a meetable mascot, she was often sighted on a massive sugar rush. (Only listed as "okay" because I'm toning this down for the age-up.)
- Jokes: Knows the Club Penguin preset jokes and may tell one if prompted.
- Card Jitsu: The only card game in Club Penguin, and she isn't very familiar with it, either. She does, however, appear on three cards, one of which being a Power Card.
- Other Disney properties: has knowledge of many Disney properties from the 2010's thanks to the many various crossover parties in Club Penguin. Get in touch with 7.grand.dad over which IPs she knows about.
- Herbert P. Bear: The Big Bad of the Club Penguin franchise. Cadence is one of three non-EPF characters to have been specifically targeted by Herbert at one point, albeit in secondary media. Touchy subject, best used for finding common ground with characters who have their own Big Bad with varying degrees of legitimacy as a threat.
- Operation Blackout: A "the villain wins" scenario where Herbert P. Bear took over the island. Amazing if you were a player, terrifying if you were an NPC like Cadence. Speaking of, Cadence had two minor roles during this time (sending an "Ask Herbert" question under the guise of her pet puffle, and releasing a single during the ban on singing and loud music), but – as she wasn't EPF – she spent nearly the entirety of the event offscreen. Plus, being an in-game mascot and not a player, this was a tragic time for her.
- Other Club Penguin Mascots: She'd be happy to tell you everything she knows about Captain Rockhopper, Aunt Arctic, etc. But she isn't as close to them as she is to Franky or The Penguin Band.
- Her Wig: Penguins don't grow hair naturally, so her hairstyle is actually a wig. Probably not the best topic for a game of strip poker, but she did dye it herself and is proud of that accomplishment. Will usually bring it up herself when she enters her "nude" phase but it's possible to have her casually drop it earlier than that.
- Her Scarf: Similarly to her wig, Cadence's scarf was completely home-made. Will mention that she 'doesn't feel like herself' without her scarf, a subtle jab at her mostly-disliked redesign from the attempted reboot "Club Penguin Island".
- Sexual Topics: Cadence is not only from a setting that's as Rated G as it gets, but has essentially acted as Disney's idea of a teenager for long after those years were behind her. She's pretty new to sex but appreciates the opportunity to blow off some steam, hence why she's okay with the forfeit. Once the game gets into the later stages, the topic has a better chance of coming up.

One-Off Topics:
- The EPF: She can tell you that the Elite Penguin Force is a secret agency that keeps Club Penguin Island safe, but don't expect anything nitty-gritty from her. She's not an agent. It's like asking Taylor Swift about the CIA or MI6; what is SHE gonna know?
- The Box Dimension: It may be the only "logical" explanation for a Club Penguin character to waddle her way into the Inventory (and I use "logically" very loosely; NOTHING about the Box Dimension is logical), but that doesn't mean she knows how it works. The smartest minds in Club Penguin BARELY have a general idea of how it works.
- Humanoid Body: The lore I'm going with for why Cadence doesn't look like a big pink pear with two webbed feet, two handless flippers and a beak is that she asked Gary the Gadget Guy transform her body into something resembling a human so that she could be permitted to play, while also being reversible for when she wants to return to Club Penguin Island. It's best to keep discussion on this topic brief as this is technically all fanon, and instead focus on the canon lives of herself and whoever she's interacting with.

Bad Topics:
- Flirting: In order to preserve the "will they/won't they" relationship with Franky, she should reject any romantic advances made onto her; accepting would firmly establish the answer as "they won't".

case.name: Nudity Issue
case.description: Club Penguin is a game where characters being "nude" isn't worth batting an eye. So when people start getting worked up over getting naked, Cadence has no idea why…

case.name: Is 2009 "Retro"?
case.description: Cadence refers to her Scarf-Only look as "Retro Cadence" before pondering if 2009 counts as "retro" yet. ((NOTE: Cadence has only one line where this comes up. Use the marker if targeting. For reference: in 2025, 2009 would be considered 16 years ago.))

case.name: Cadence Story
case.description: To compensate for taking off an accessory, Cadence opts to tell the table about a major event from her life. ((NOTE: There are multiple stories, each with different markers. Read the note attached to this case by clicking the blue "Go To Case" arrow.))

case.name: It's A Wig
case.description: When explaining that she's not willing to remove her headphones for the game, she casually drops the fact that she's wearing a wig.

case.name: But First, Lemme Take A…
case.description: Cadence may take a selfie in the middle of an opponent's Stripping phase if they're stripping a minor item. (Get in touch with her writer, 7.grand.dad, if you'd like to call her out on this, he'd be happy to continue the conversation instead of move on to the Instagram post.)

case.name: Shy First Strip
case.description: When a character with the "shy" tag must strip for the first time, Cadence will take notice of their attitude and spend the rest of the game consoling the shy character. She has plenty of generics to cover the cases, but if you'd like more "personalized" targets, here's where it all starts.

case.name: Coins For Change
case.description: As the Christmas Season comes around, Cadence will mention Coins For Change, Club Penguin's annual charity that would rack up millions of real world dollars every year to help various causes around the globe.

case.name: Halloween
case.description: As Halloween approaches, Cadence prompts the group about their favorite Halloween traditions while also sharing her own favorite tradition.

True story, by the way. In 2013, Club Penguin's "Coins For Change" charity garnered enough donations from its player base to equate $10,000,000, every dime of which went towards things like providing clean water to Ecuador, snow leopard conservation in Russia, a maternity ward in Malawa, toys for orphanages in the United States, nesting grounds for REAL penguins in the REAL Antarctica, and so much more.
